content: Jesu A Myi Thaw Qunaak
Khaw khquk nyn a awm coengawh Jesu ing Piter, Jakob ingkaw a na Johan ce khy nawh a mimah doeng tlang ak sang na ce kaai pyi hy.
Cawh ce a mingmih a haiawh a myi ce thaw pehy. A hai ce khawmik amyihna vang nawh, a hi awm khawkdai amyihna baawk hy.
Cawh cekkhqi a haiawh Mosi ingkaw Elijah ce dang pe nawh Jesu mi ce pau uhy.
Cawh Piter ing Jesu a venawh, “Bawipa, vawh awm aham nep soeih hy. Na ngaih awhtaw buk pakthum heen law vang - nang aham pynoet, Mosi aham pynoet, Elijah aham pynoet seh,” tina hy.
Awi ak kqawn huili awh, myi ak vang thlang ing a mingmih ce zawl khqi khoep nawh, myi ak khui awhkaw awi ing, “Vetaw ka lungnaak ka Capa ni; ak khan awh zeel soeih nyng; ak awi ngai pe uh!” tihy.
A hubatkhqi ing a ming zaak awh kqih soeih unawh a bukhup na koep uhy.
Cehlai Jesu ing law nawh cekkhqi ce bi hy, “

content.text: Koeh kqih uh, tho hlah uh

content: ,” tina hy.
A mingmih ing ami toek awhtaw, Jesu doeng am kaana taw u awm ak chang am hu uhy.
Tlang nakawng ami nuk kqum awh, Jesu ing cekkhqi ce awi yn hy, “

content.text: Thlanghqing Capa ve thihnaak awhkawng a thawh hlan dy taw, vawhkaw ik-oeih nami huh ve u a venawh awm koeh kqawn uh

content: ,” tinak khqi hy.
A hubatkhqi ing doet uhy, “kawtih anaa cawngpyikung khqi ing Elijah lamma na law kaw, a mi ti?” tina uhy.
Jesu ing cekkhqi venawh, “

content.text: Elijah ve lamma na law tak kawmsaw ik-oeihkhqi boeih ce ak nep na sai tlaih kaw.

Cehlai ka nik kqawn peek khqi, Elijah taw law hawh hlai hy, a mingmih ing am hat uhy, ami ngaih saqui ce ak khan awh sai pe uhy, cemih lawt na thlanghqing Capa ingawm a mingmih a kut awh khuikha kaw,”

content: tina hy.
Baptisma ak pekung Johan akawng ni a mingmih a venawh ak kqawn peek, tice a hubatkhqi ing zasim uhy.
Qaai Ing Am Tu Nasen Qoei Saknaak
Thlang kqeng a venna a mi law awh, thlang pynoet ce a venawh law nawh ak khawkung awh khuk sym pehy.
“Bawipa ka capa ak khan awh qeennaak ta law cang lah, qaw nawh khuikha khing hawh hy. Mai awh tlu poepa hawh hy.
Na hubatkhqi venawh khyn hlai nyng, am qoei sak thai uhy,” tina hy.
Cawh Jesu ing, “

content.text: Aw cangnaak amak ta thlangkhqi ingkaw kawlung ak hqamkhqi, nangmih ve iqyt nu ka ni awm pyi khqi kaw? Iqyt nu ka ning yh pyi khqi kaw? Ka venna hawlaw lah uh

content: ,” tinak khqi hy.
Jesu ing qaai ce zyi nawh, qaai ing cawhkaw naasen ce cehta hy, cawh anih ce qoei tlang hy.
Cekcoengawh a hubatkhqi ing aha cana Jesu a venna law unawh, “kawtih kaimih ingtaw am ka mi hqek thai?” tina uhy.
Jesu ing a mingmih a venawh, “

content.text: Namik cangnaak a zawi a dawngawh ni. Awtak ka nik kqawn peek khqi, antlam ak ui teh mah cangnaak nami taak mantaw, vawhkaw tlang a venawh, 'vawhkawng cena thoeih lah,' nami tinaak awh thoeih kaw. Nangmih aham amak coeng thai ikaw awm am awm kaw.
Cehlai vemih ve cykcahnaak ingkaw buh zeihnaak doeng am ingtaw am cet thai hy,”

content: tina hy.
Kalili qam na ami law awh, Jesu ing a mingmih a venawh, “

content.text: Thlanghqing Capa ve thlangkhqi kut awh pe kawm usaw tu sak kawm uh.
Him kawm usaw, am thum nyn awh tho tlaih kaw,”

content: tina hy. Ce ak awi ce a ming zaak awh a hubatkhqi taw amik kaw map hqoeng hy.
Bawkim Awhkaw Mangmu
Kapernaum khaw ami pha law awh mangmu ak cawikhqi ce Piter a venna law unawh, “Nangmih a cawngpyikung ing pumim tangka am cawi nawh aw?” tinawh doet uhy.
Anih ing, “Cawi hy,” tinawh hlat hy. Imna a mi luh awh Jesu ing khai nawh, “

content.text: Simon, ikawmyihna nak poek? Khawmdek sangpahrangkhqi ing u venna nu mangmu ami cawi? Ami cakhqi venna nu, thlak chang vena?

content: ” tinawh doet hy.
Piter ing a venawh, “Thlak chang a venawh,” tina hy. Jesu ing, “

content.text: Cawhtaw a cakhqi taw loet timaw ce.
Cehlai amik kaw a zeelnaak aham, tuili na cet nawh cikkoeih vak thla. Ngam nam tu ma ce lo nawh am kha ce phen pe, tangka hu kawp ti. Lo nawh kai ingkaw namimah hamna cawi

content: ,” tina hy.
